ce_bugs.text: lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — Splitting SETNX and EXPIRE can leave a permanent throttle key if the worker dies between calls, so the embed stays on the loading page forever without a retry path.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — Embed identity uses the unnormalized URL, so attacker-controlled fragments or equivalent URL spellings can create duplicate topics for one resource.
db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb:3 — The default value 1 selects raw_html, so every existing and ordinary new post bypasses the normal cooking pipeline.
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Changing this historical migration to `force: true` drops any existing `top_topics` table and its data when it is applied.
db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — force: true` can drop a pre-existing `topic_embeds` table during migration, irreversibly deleting embeds instead of failing safely.

lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — Every cache-miss embed retrieval synchronously runs the full feed poll, so distinct URLs can repeatedly download, parse, and reimport the entire feed outside its hourly schedule.

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — The feed response and all RSS items are materialized without a size/item bound, allowing a large configured feed to consume unbounded worker memory and processing time.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — Remote article retrieval has no connection or read timeout, so a stalled embed host can occupy a Sidekiq worker indefinitely.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — Feed/import HTML is stored with `raw_html` and skipped validations, allowing a hostile source page or feed item to persist executable XSS.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — The initial embed host check is bypassed by HTTP redirects followed by `open`, allowing an allowed external URL to redirect the server to internal services (SSRF).

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 — The no-embed test still expects synchronous TopicRetriever invocation although the controller now enqueues :retrieve_topic, so this changed path is untested and the spec fails.

mrv_findings.text: [100][P1] app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:1 — `require_dependency 'email/sender'` — no matching file exists, so the queued job cannot load.
[75][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` — `open-uri` is only required by the unrelated feed job, so direct retrieval can treat the URL as a local file.
[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:11 — `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` — prefix-only validation admits malformed HTTP-prefixed URLs, with no acceptance test for that invalid-URI class.
[75][P2] spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:14 — `poll_feed if SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && ...` — feed tests cover only configuration guards, not RSS parsing, item import, or URL fallback behavior.

[100][P2] db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — `create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|` — alters unrelated top-topics schema behavior with no traceability to the stated embed URL handling/validation intent.
[75][P1] lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — `if $redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1") ... $redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)` — a crash between operations permanently suppresses retrieval for that URL.
[75][P2] app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — `embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` — check-then-create races concurrent importers; the unique-index loser raises instead of being idempotent.

[75][P2] app/models/topic_embed.rb:34 — `revisor.revise!(user, absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, bypass_rate_limiter: true)` — post update and SHA write lack locking/versioning, allowing concurrent imports to leave mismatched content and digest.
[75][P2] app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `open(url).read` — remote fetch has no timeout, so a stalled origin can occupy a worker indefinitely.
[75][P2] lib/topic_retriever.rb:40 — `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` — every embed cache miss synchronously processes the entire feed, creating an unbounded unrelated hot path.

[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — `PostCreator.new(user, title: title, raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` — attacker-controlled feed content becomes stored, unsanitized HTML and executes as XSS.
[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `doc = Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` — unvalidated server-side fetches permit SSRF through redirects or non-HTTP schemes.

[75][P2] app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:11 — `parent.postMessage({type: 'discourse-resize', height: document['body'].offsetHeight}, '<%= request.referer %>');` — an apostrophe in a valid configured-host Referer can break the JavaScript literal and execute reflected script.
[75][P2] app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 — `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` — substring origin validation accepts prefix attacker origins, allowing forged resize messages.

[100][P1] spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40 — `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` — the test expects retrieval directly but production queues `Jobs.enqueue`, so it does not exercise the shipped queue payload/rendering path.

[100][P1] spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:31 — `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once` — positive tests replace the changed worker with a mock, so no test verifies feed parsing, URL fallback, or import side effects.

[75][P2] spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:32 — `topic_retriever.expects(:perform_retrieve).once` — tests mock the only retrieval behavior and never trigger its new existing-embed, feed, or HTTP-fallback branches.

[75][P2] spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:39 — `post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/` — the update test does not verify content-SHA persistence, so a failed revision followed by SHA advancement could be missed.

[100][P1] db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — `create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|` — modifying an already-released migration to force-drop/recreate the table can lose ranking rows without preservation.

[75][P1] db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true do |t|` — force-creating the table can drop an existing pre-provisioned table and destroy embed-to-topic mappings.
